From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Apr 2025 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Medisys redline — request: deal-desk / exec path

Team —

I reviewed Medisys' redlines. We should not accept uncapped liability. Recommended path:
- Maintain $1M general liability cap but create a narrow carve-out for confirmed, direct third-party data breach damages capped at $2.5M and subject to proof of loss;
- Keep indemnity tight and reciprocal where possible; do not accept broad indemnity for miscellaneous commercial claims;
- Warranty: agree to a limited 18-month warranty for the analytics module only (not the whole platform) tied to explicit acceptance tests;
- Require DPA + SOC 2 Type II evidence and predefined remediation timelines.

If customer insists on $3M indemnity or full uncapped breach exposure, we need exec-level approval (CEO/Head of Revenue) because of balance sheet risk. From a legal standpoint the $2.5M carve-out + DPA + SLA credits is defensible.

I can draft the redline language and a short one-pager that summarizes residual risk for exec review.

Laura Bennett
Head of Contracts & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Apr 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Medisys redline — request: deal-desk / exec path

Agree with Laura's approach. Commercially: 40% pilot credit is beyond our deal-desk threshold. I can approve up to a 25% discount if we hold to the $2.5M data-breach carve-out, DPA signed, and 50% upfront payment. Anything beyond that needs CRO/CEO sign-off.

Monica — please prepare the one-pager Laura mentioned and route to Rishi and Priya (CC'd if needed) for final sign-off. Also include an updated margin impact sheet for finance. Timebox the ask — customer expects a final SOW by May 9.

Vivek

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Apr 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Request for executive approval: Medisys variation (summary attached)

Rishi —

Looping you in for a quick decision. Summary: Medisys requests uncapped breach indemnity (~$3M ask), 24-month warranty on analytics, and 40% pilot credit. Legal (Laura) recommends $2.5M carve-out limited to direct data breach damages + 18-month analytics warranty, and Sales can stretch to 25% discount with 50% upfront payment. Finance (Aditya) called out the margin impact in the attached sheet.

Can you provide a one-off approval to proceed on the compromise below? If yes, we will present the counter-offer (language attached) and aim to get SOW signed by May 9:
- Liability: $2.5M carve-out (data breach)
- Warranty: 18 months for analytics module only
- Discount: 25% pilot credit
- Conditions: signed DPA + 50% upfront invoiced on signature

If you prefer, we can bring this to the CEO for full sign-off, but per Vivek this fits within a CFO/CRO approval band if Rishi concurs.

Thanks,
Marissa

Monica/Marissa: proceed to present this to Kayla and her counsel. Laura, please attach the one-pager risk memo to the SOW package when you send it to the customer.
